Device D001825 has a generic desktop profile with zero confirmed fraud cases all-time, no proxy usage, and ring_id -1, with only card C03042-K1 active on it in the 30-day window.
Card C03042-K1 has extensive online transaction history (56 of 68 prior transactions) and frequent activity in product category R (23 transactions), consistent with transaction 3464869.
Shared origin analysis for transaction 3464869 demonstrates no fraud clustering, with email anonymous.com showing a lift of 0.64 and region 327 showing a lift of 0.60 against baseline.

Historical closed cases on card C03042-K1 include cleared travel alert CC-1313, while previous confirmed fraud cases CC-3886 and CC-0615 were customer-reported disputes from mobile safari iOS devices months earlier.
Similar closed cases triggered by high model or risk scores without customer dispute, such as CC-5371, CC-2037, and CC-5368, were cleared with no fraud found.

case.summary: Transaction 3464869 for $599.94 on card C03042-K1 was flagged by an elevated legacy risk score of 0.77. The bank's calibrated second-generation fraud model scored the transaction at 0.016 with a historical fraud rate of only 0.006, reflecting very low risk. The purchase matches the cardholder's established pattern of online shopping and category R purchases. Additionally, device D001825 shows no proxy usage or link to suspicious device rings, and shared origin indicators showed no fraud clustering. The transaction is determined to be legitimate cardholder activity.
